System architecture

WarningOutline

This page defines the documentation scope. It is not yet a complete or verified architecture description.

Purpose

Describe how Excel, the NADABAS VBA add-in, workbooks, the database, the Windows registry, file storage, and external interfaces cooperate at runtime.

Planned content

  • system context and supported deployment variants;
  • component responsibilities and trust boundaries;
  • startup, authentication, and connection lifecycle;
  • principal data flows for load, save, classification, correspondence, and batch processing;
  • failure boundaries and recovery behaviour;
  • current VBA architecture and the seams intended for gradual .NET migration.

Evidence required

The final page must be checked against the exported modules, classes, and forms below vba/. Security-sensitive flows must also be checked against the security scanner and operational configuration. Architecture diagrams should be stored as Mermaid source where practical.

Definition of done

  • Every component in the diagram has an owner and a linked reference page.
  • Data stores and trust boundaries are explicit.
  • No credentials, production paths, or environment-specific secrets appear in examples.
  • The description names the NADABAS versions it has been verified against.
